expected_behavior: Extract ground truth bounding boxes of difficult small lesion crop 2x context window resize to 640x640 and update dataset sample with cropped patch
found_behavior: Code calls label.get('bboxes') which is None in Ultralytics 8.4 (bboxes are stored in label['instances'].bboxes). Length of orig_boxes is 0 so new_bboxes is empty and _is_context_cropped is never set. __getitem__ falls through to standard baseline transforms.
historical_impact: Targeted context augmentation in EXP-2 and EXP-3 was an unintended silent NO-OP during training. EXP-2 executed as a duplicate baseline (EXP-0) and EXP-3 executed as a duplicate adaptive sampling run (EXP-1).
proposed_fix: Extract orig_boxes from label['instances'].bboxes (normalized xywh) transform to crop space and create a new Instances object assigned to label['instances'] before passing to crop_transforms.
required_regression_test: Unit test loading a target small image verifying len(label['instances'].bboxes) > 0 and label['_is_context_cropped'] is True with resized patch of shape (640 640 3).

expected_behavior: Extract per-class AP@50 (val_metrics.box.ap50) into per_class_map50 and per-class AP@50-95 (val_metrics.box.maps) into per_class_map50_95
found_behavior: Code assigned val_metrics.box.maps into per_class_map50 causing AP@50-95 to be reported under AP@50 column headers in summary JSON and markdown tables.
historical_impact: Mislabeled per-class AP in Stage 8 summary reports creating metric inconsistency until reconciled in Stage 9.1.
proposed_fix: Explicitly extract val_metrics.box.ap50 as per_class_ap50 and val_metrics.box.maps as per_class_map50_95 into separate unambiguous dictionary keys.
required_regression_test: Unit test asserting that the mean of per_class_ap50 matches val_metrics.box.map50 and mean of per_class_map50_95 matches val_metrics.box.map.

expected_behavior: Model selection candidate should be determined strictly by highest validation mAP@50-95 (pre-registered primary criterion)
found_behavior: Ad-hoc 0.5% margin condition (top_candidate['mAP50_95'] - r['mAP50_95'] <= 0.005) triggered tie-breaking and promoted EXP-2 over EXP-0 based on recall_small
historical_impact: Contradicted primary validation mAP@50-95 ranking (EXP-0: 26.58% vs EXP-2: 26.24%) and led to conflicting narratives regarding model selection.
proposed_fix: Enforce strict primary validation ranking where EXP-0 is declared the official validation winner and secondary metrics (recall_small) are reported as diagnostic insights.
required_regression_test: Test asserting that if model A has higher mAP@50-95 than model B model A is selected as winner regardless of secondary metrics.

expected_behavior: Greedy one-to-one bipartite matching between ground-truth objects and model predictions
found_behavior: Loop over predictions did not exclude already matched predictions allowing multiple GT objects to match the same prediction
historical_impact: Minor distortion in TP and error taxonomy counts when ground-truth objects were closely clustered in Stage 7 baseline analysis.
proposed_fix: Port the clean greedy bipartite matching implementation from stage_8_2_build_difficulty_manifest.py into stage_7.
required_regression_test: Synthetic unit test with 2 GT objects and 1 prediction verifying only one GT object is matched.

expected_behavior: Scale normalized coordinates dynamically by actual image dimensions (W H)
found_behavior: Code hardcoded multiplication by 640.0 assuming square 640x640 dimensions
historical_impact: Zero distortion on current cassava-v7 dataset (all 12829 images are verified exactly 640x640) but vulnerable if non-640 images are introduced.
proposed_fix: Pass image dimensions (W H) dynamically or perform matching directly in normalized [0 1] coordinates.
required_regression_test: Unit test with non-square image dimensions (e.g. 1280x720) verifying correct coordinate transformation.
